subject: Post-demo: Security kickoff + procurement path — stakeholder next steps
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Lewis <hannah@pegasoft.com>, Amir Sayed <amir.sayed@pegasoft.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Security kickoff + procurement path — stakeholder next steps

Hi Hannah / Amir —

Great to meet earlier today — thanks for the time and for walking us through Pegasoft's high-level use case for customer support augmentation. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we all have the same playbook: 

1) Security intake & scope: you mentioned a standard vendor RFI and that the networking team will need a diagram. If you can share the RFI, we’ll populate the answers and attach our SOC2/Security pack.

2) Stakeholder mapping: per our call, primary decision-makers are: 
   - Economic buyer: Amir Sayed (VP Product) — cost/ROI lead
   - Procurement: procurement@pegasoft.com — standard T&Cs + PO cadence
   - Security/Infra: Hannah Lewis — systems boundary and data flow owner

3) Decision criteria you flagged: data residency, data retention controls, audit logs, and throughput latency under 200ms P50 for support queries.

4) Proposed immediate actions (owners):
   - Pegasoft: upload RFI + network diagram (Hannah) — target Mon 5/24
   - Redwood: fill RFI, attach SOC2, architecture notes (Irene & Vivek) — target Wed 5/26
   - Procurement path: intro to Redwood finance (Aditya) once RFI/Qs resolved

Attachments: we can send a stubbed questionnaire and the standard security pack. Please confirm who should receive the filled RFI (hannah@ or procurement@).

If that alignment looks right, I’ll kick off the security intake and loop in Marissa from CS for onboarding/entitlements once contract talks start.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

--
Attachment stub: Redwood_Security_Pack_v2027-01.pdf (security pack, 8 pages)
From: Hannah Lewis <hannah@pegasoft.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amir Sayed <amir.sayed@pegasoft.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security kickoff + procurement path — stakeholder next steps

Thanks, Irene —

That summary is perfect and captures the ask. I'm attaching our standard RFI (lightweight) and the network diagram export. Procurement copied on this thread; they'll handle standard terms and PO timing.

A couple clarifications from my side: 
- Systems in scope: customer-facing support UI + interaction logs (no PII ingestion; PII is redacted upstream).
- Retention: we enforce a 90-day default, but we can negotiate a 30-90-365 matrix depending on environment.
- Audit logs: we need immutable token-level logging for the dedicated deployment; please confirm retention and export format.

Uploading RFI: Pegasoft_RFI_20270520.xlsx
Network diagram: Pegasoft_network_diagram_v1.pdf

We aim to have procurement's initial review by end of next week (5/28); Amir will confirm budget slice after that.

Cheers,
Hannah
Hannah Lewis
Head of Infrastructure Security, Pegasoft
--
Attachment stubs: Pegasoft_RFI_20270520.xlsx; Pegasoft_network_diagram_v1.pdf
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: Security kickoff + procurement path — Pegasoft RFI inbound

Vivek / Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Pegasoft's RFI and network diagram. High level asks from Pegasoft: immutable token-level logging, configurable retention windows, and confirmation of latency SLO for support workload.

Vivek — can you: 
  - review the RFI and draft concise answers for sections: auth/data flow, audit logs, deployment variants (hosted vs dedicated), and quantization/latency expectations? Aim for a single-sheet summary + RFI answers.

Marissa — procurement will likely request a contact for MSA/PO items; please prepare the standard onboarding/ops SLAs summary we hand to procurement teams. Also include entitlements and role mapping for their security team.

Aditya — can you prepare an intro note for procurement once we have the RFI filled (include expected list price bands and timeline for Dedicated if they choose reserved capacity)?

Timeline: I’d like a draft back by Wed 5/26 so we can send to Pegasoft and avoid blocking their procurement review.

Thanks —
Irene

Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo: Security kickoff + procurement path — Pegasoft RFI inbound

Thanks for the forward — happy to own onboarding/ops once contract sign-off begins. Quick notes: 

- I'll assemble the MSA / PO guidance doc and entitlements matrix and attach to the reply to procurement.
- For the immutable token logs, do we want to propose both (a) streaming export to a customer S3 + (b) 90-day immutable store on Redwood with CSV export every 7 days? Vivek, do we have storage cost estimates for that profile?
- I'll also include a short checklist for their Security Ops team describing how Redwood's audit events map to Pegasoft's SOC requirements.

I'll wait for Vivek's tech answers and then put together the combined package for Pegasoft (RFI answers + security pack + procurement packet). Targeting to send to Hannah on Wed 5/26 PST.

—Marissa
